scene.heading: DMART'S SHORT-TERM BORROWINGS (DUE WITHIN A YEAR)

stamps.at: More than two and a half

say: D Mart has also been borrowing. In March, its short term borrowings were nine hundred and sixty five crore rupees. By the end of September: two thousand six hundred and twenty nine crore. More than two and a half times as much, in six months. Is that too much? We will weigh it in a minute.
